about: Owner decisions on difficulty labels. {"<connection id>": {"tier": "easy|medium|hard|expert", "note": "why"}}. Applied last, over every rating. Add entries after reviewing difficulty-review-queue.md, then run node scripts/library/activate.mjs.

CARD-002.note: Classic list; thiamine deficiency and AV fistula pull toward other groups.

CARD-007.note: Standard rate-control drugs, but each tile also fits its own drug-class group.

ENDO-010.note: Peripheral deiodinase effect is a mechanism detail; amiodarone is the less familiar member.

ENDO-021.note: Core physiology, described as effects rather than a named list.

ENDO-028.note: Needs reasoning from reduced renal perfusion; reninoma is rarely taught.

ENDO-031.note: Four "deficiency" tiles group on sight; the title framing is the only subtle part.

ENDO-032.note: Electrolytes point to adrenal insufficiency in general; 17-OHP and renin decide it.

ENDO-035.note: Needs DHT versus testosterone reasoning for each tile.

GI-014.note: Classic pernicious anemia chain, with tiles that also fit B12 groups.

GI-030.note: Standard pre-, intra- and posthepatic list; schistosomiasis is the less familiar member.

MSK-041.note: Generic lab tiles that pull toward acidosis and rhabdomyolysis groups.

NEPH-008.note: Classic findings, given as biopsy descriptions.

NEPH-012.note: Classic, but subepithelial deposits overlap membranous nephropathy.

NEPH-017.note: Each exposure needs a mechanism step to oxalate.

NEU-009.note: Classic lesion, but each tile needs a laterality check.

PLEXUS-GEN-009.note: Standard pathway steps; polymerase and ligase also fit other repair groups.

PLX-BCH-007.note: Four "Type ... collagen" tiles group on sight; which types are fibrillar is the harder part.

PLX-BCH-022.note: Classic Kartagener features, but the tiles also fit cystic fibrosis and immunodeficiency groups.

PLX-BCH-023.note: Lab-description tiles; normal urinary GAGs must be told apart from the mucopolysaccharidoses.

PLX-BCH-066.note: Standard amino acid classification, less drilled; serine and threonine pull toward hydroxyl groups.

PLX-HEM-014.note: Less taught; echinocytes and generic hemolysis tiles fit other hemolytic anemias.
